About the photos

The people in flok are invented. The photos are real: ordinary pictures that real people posted to Wikimedia Commons under open licenses. They are cropped to fit the feed. Nothing else is changed.

    CC BY and CC BY-SA photos are used under those licenses; the cropped versions stay under the same license. CC0 photos are public domain.
